description: precice is an open-source software tool listed in best-of-ps, a ranked list of open-source power-system-analysis projects under the section "co-simulation framework", published or maintained by precice (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). Precise Code Interaction Coupling Environment. Coverage: not geographically bound. The list files it under "co-simulation framework". It reports 970 GitHub stars and a last repository update on 2026-09-23. Implementation language: C++. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is LGPL-3.0 (as given in the list). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support coupling power-system models with other simulators. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-best-of-ps.
